verdict.rationale: Corporations Canada's own pages say the incorporation application can be submitted and paid through its Online Filing Centre. They publish an online fee of $200 with 1-day processing (plus 4-hour express), and the paper PDF route is shown only as a slower fallback. Annual returns and post-incorporation changes such as director amendments can also be filed online. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that an online filing was completed end to end.
